name: Electric Eels
description: A swarm of eels that encircle and electrocute.

abilities.name: Horde (2d4+1)
abilities.description: When the Eels have marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals 2d4+1 physical damage instead.

abilities.name: Paralyzing Shock
abilities.description: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against all targets within Very Close range. You gain a Fear for each target that marks HP.
